title.purpose: Card titles, list headers, app bar title.

cinema-display.purpose: Discovery-only spotlight title and section headers.

shadows.name: card-lift
shadows.purpose: Event cards and cinema cards; the only shadow on flat surfaces.

shadows.name: nav-bar-lift
shadows.purpose: Bottom nav bar, cast upward since the bar sits at the screen's bottom edge.

motion.name: press-scale
motion.purpose: Universal tactile feedback on every button, nav item, and tappable card (NSPressScale).

components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #2563EB; color: #FCFCFD; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: 14px; height: 50px; width: 100%; border: none; border-radius: 12px; transition: transform 0.1s ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.96); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Outlined ghost button, same footprint as primary.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: transparent; color: #0F172A; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: 14px; height: 50px; width: 100%; border: 1px solid #E2E8F0; border-radius: 12px; transition: transform 0.1s ease-out; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: scale(0.96); }

components.name: Category Chip
components.description: Pill filter chip; selected (filled) and unselected (outlined) states.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-block; padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 20px; border: 1px solid #E2E8F0; background: #FCFCFD; color: #0F172A; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; } .ds-chip-selected { background: #2563EB; border-color: #2563EB; color: #FCFCFD; font-weight: 700; }

components.name: Event Card
components.description: 150px-wide browse-rail card: image, title, category, price.
components.html:
Dune: Part Three
Movie
€12.00 onwards
components.css: .ds-card { width: 150px; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; } .ds-card-image { height: 200px; border-radius: 12px; background: #E2E8F0; margin-bottom: 8px; } .ds-card-title { font-weight: 700; font-size: 14px; color: #0F172A; } .ds-card-meta { font-size: 12px; color: #64748B; } .ds-card-price { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; color: #22C55E; margin-top: 4px; }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: Semantic pill badge; background always the same token as text at 15% opacity.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-block; padding: 4px 8px; border-radius: 12px; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; } .ds-badge-success { background: rgba(34,197,94,0.15); color: #22C55E; }

components.name: Bottom Nav Bar
components.description: Frosted-glass fixed bottom nav; active tab gets a soft pill highlight.
components.html:
🎬 Discover
🎟 Tickets
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; justify-content: space-around; padding: 8px 0; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.72); backdrop-filter: blur(20px); border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.6); box-shadow: 0 -6px 24px rgba(15,23,42,0.06); } .ds-nav-item { font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; color: #64748B; padding: 6px 14px; border-radius: 16px; } .ds-nav-item-active { color: #2563EB; font-weight: 700; background: rgba(37,99,235,0.12); }

components.name: Cinema Glass Badge
components.description: Signature Discovery-only frosted pill (icon + label) floating over imagery.
components.css: .ds-glass-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; padding: 6px 10px; border-radius: 999px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.10); backdrop-filter: blur(12px); color: #F5F7FA; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; }

narrative.overview:
The app reads as a ticket counter: efficient, legible, trustworthy. Royal blue is the one accent that recurs everywhere — buttons, links, selected states, the brand gradient in the wordmark — sitting on near-white surfaces with a restrained Manrope/Inter type pairing. Screens are flat, high-contrast, and built for scanning a list of showtimes fast; there is no ornamental chrome, no gratuitous shadow, no decorative color beyond the functional success/warning/error trio.

One screen breaks the rule on purpose: Discovery (the home tab) drops to a near-black, glassmorphic "Cinema" system — dark background, frosted-blur badges and nav, Space Grotesk display type, and one saturated color per event category. It's the moment the app becomes the thing it sells tickets to — walking from the lobby (light, functional) into the screening room (dark, immersive) — before returning to the light system for every task screen.
keyCharacteristics: One brand accent (Royal Blue), used sparingly and consistently across both light and dark worlds.
Light system is flat and utilitarian; the Discovery-only dark system is glassmorphic and cinematic.
Manrope for headings/emphasis, Inter for body/labels, Space Grotesk reserved exclusively for Discovery's dark screens.
A single named category-color set (movie/comedy/music/theatre) exists only inside Discovery's category grid.
Every primary interactive element scales to 96% on press — the app's one consistent tactile signature.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Royal Blue is the only color ever used for interactive/brand meaning. Every other hue stays fixed to its single role.

rules.name: The Discovery Exception
rules.body: Dark surface tokens (cinema-*) exist only for the Discovery tab and never fall back to the light system's palette.

rules.name: The Two-Typeface Rule
rules.body: Only Manrope and Inter appear outside Discovery. Space Grotesk is a Discovery-only accent typeface.

rules.name: The Float Rule
rules.body: Blur and shadow are reserved for elements conceptually floating above content (nav bar, glass badges). Everything else sits flush at rest.

dos: Do keep Royal Blue as the only interactive/brand accent across both the light and dark systems.
Do confine CinemaColors/CinemaTextStyles/Space Grotesk strictly to Discovery.
Do reserve blur + shadow for surfaces that are conceptually floating.
Do apply the 0.96 press-scale to every new tappable primary/card component.
Do treat shared/ui_kit as the single canonical source for cross-app component tokens.
donts: Don't introduce a second accent color; semantic and category colors stay fixed to their single roles.
Don't use the light system's NSSecondaryButton/NSEmptyState/NSErrorState on Discovery's dark background.
Don't add drop shadows to flat elements — shadow is reserved for nav bar and cards only.
Don't hardcode hex values in screens; reference NSColors/NSTextStyles or CinemaColors/CinemaTextStyles.
